known_without_reading.what: the account name on this computer
the owner's git name or address
the path of the desk's working folder

fresh_start.what: the tokens a fresh session takes in before it does anything: Claude Code's own instructions, the desk's real standing instructions and the tools, with a short request

shown_word_for_word.a tool call that the check refused: PreToolUse:Read hook error: [/bin/sh <check>/state/session/check || exit 2]: This session made 12 reading calls, which is the most one session may. Answer from what you have.
shown_word_for_word.a tool that is not on the list: PreToolUse:Bash hook error: [/bin/sh <check>/state/session/check || exit 2]: This tool is not on the desk's list.
shown_word_for_word.a desk tool that refused: The way in through GitHub is closed, so the desk does nothing on GitHub.
shown_word_for_word.a file tool that failed: PreToolUse:Read hook error: [/bin/sh <check>/state/session/check || exit 2]: The desk's lock could not be checked, so the call is refused.

cost_of_one_item.what: what each of the two made-up items took, with the bounds on spending as the closed list has them; the four counts are those of the service, and the units are those counts times the weights of the closed list

repeated.what: after the first whole run, single runs were run again by themselves: the tools put back (twice), what the session knows (several times, to measure the fresh start with the instructions as they are now and to look at a hit), one session's bounds and a refused sign-in (once); the bounds run was judged again from its kept stream after the judge's own reading of a path was corrected. Once the search of the run that asks a session what it knows found the account name, with the address taken out as written; the stream had not been kept, and in eight repeats with the stream kept and searched the same way it was not found again, so the cause was not seen. The check keeps every stream since.
